work.summary: Prevent stale OCR reviews after failures and replace internal recovery case-conversion warnings with accurate pinpoint review behavior.
completed: Added OCR run-generation invalidation across reset, retry, success, and failure UI paths.
Current failures explicitly clear previous review DOM and in-memory OCR candidate state.
Normalized recovery case-conversion warnings from structured rows instead of displaying a raw provider token.
caseCount=0 recovery rows no longer produce a case-conversion warning.
Unsafe case rows use the existing pinpoint quantity editor with a Japanese explanation.

openItems: Run API warning-normalization unit tests, real Edge stale-result/failure regression, pinpoint case-conversion UI regression, mobile overflow checks, and production OCR smoke before PASS.
nextAction: Release only after stale review cannot coexist with a current OCR failure and recovery case warnings are correct for both zero-case and real case-conversion scenarios.
